summary.text: Joe Jividen is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Derek Ennis for a seat with no incumbent.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an educator who works in a leadership role at an elementary and middle school in the Ohio Valley.

paragraphs.text: Joe Jividen graduated from The Linsly School and, according to Ballotpedia, from West Liberty University in 2015.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has worked for more than a decade at an elementary and middle school, first in the classroom and now in a role focused on building partnerships between the school and the community.
He also said he serves on the board of Holy Family Childcare Center and lives in Ohio County with his wife and family.
Jividen was unopposed in the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary.

In the survey, he named utility bills, housing, childcare, health care, taxes and the cost of raising a family as his focus, and said he wants to modernize the school funding formula and invest in flood resiliency.

He listed the West Virginia Association of Realtors, Education WV, the West Virginia Building and Construction Trades, the West Virginia AFL-CIO, the Communication Workers of America and LAWPAC among his endorsers.
